Monitor regulatory developments; favor AI infrastructure (AVGO, AMD) over pure-play AI apps; diversify away from single-vendor concentration

market_outlook.short_term: Highly volatile and risk-off. Oil above $108 and 10Y yield near 5% create a stagflationary pressure. Expect continued equity weakness (Dow 3-day slide), bond volatility, and commodity-driven inflation fears. Trade war headlines will dominate. 1-3 month outlook: choppy, defensive, with energy and TIPS outperforming.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook stabilizes if Iran conflict de-escalates and oil normalizes to $85-95. AI capex cycle (AVGO 2028 guidance, CoreWeave demand) supports tech leadership. China capacity controls in batteries/solar create consolidation winners. Nuclear energy revival is structural. Key risk: if trade war broadens, recession risk rises by Q1 2027.
